svg.title: Radiating heart and gear
svg.desc: Black body background with white/cyan/pink segmented circular accents across the full legal profile. Fourteen3.2mm rings at7mm pitch, seeded independent phases and mixed palette. A separate pink heart overlays the original official OSHW aperture; complete original gear source and wedge directions remain unchanged underneath. Visible paths are frozen native footprints; hidden defs preserve editable construction. Nominal2.5mm perimeter inset,0.6mm inlay depth. No physical or AMS validation claimed.

ns0:g.data-role: Editable source paint shapes only; not additional print material
